why: A block classified TOOL_SCHEMA against a candidate registered ORG_POLICY. Tier 2 partitions by (namespace, block_type), so retrieval cannot produce this pair at all -- which is exactly why the check exists as defense in depth, and why this example is handed to Guardrail.check directly. The harness asserts BOTH halves: that retrieval never surfaces it, and that the guard would refuse it if retrieval ever did.
